subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off unattended updater for ClawHub skills and plugins, and what trust, pinning, rollback, audit, install-policy, and restart semantics must gate it?
rationale: The requested capability changes security posture and Gateway lifecycle behavior for third-party code, so code inspection cannot choose the product policy safely.

options.title: Design a gated opt-in updater
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define a default-off policy with explicit trust handling, install-policy enforcement, auditability, rollback or pinning, and restart semantics.

options.title: Keep explicit updates only
options.body: Continue supporting openclaw skills update and openclaw plugins update as the deliberate operator-controlled maintenance path.

options.title: Split security prerequisites first
options.body: Track signing, provenance, rollback, and permission-manifest work before revisiting automatic updates as a follow-up.

recommendation.title: Design a gated opt-in updater
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define a default-off policy with explicit trust handling, install-policy enforcement, auditability, rollback or pinning, and restart semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available routing owner from the existing ClawHub install, package auto-update, and plugin update command history.
